ITEM 1 | Pile of small smooth tan-brown oval nuts with matte, dry, slightly ridged shells, spread across the upper left and center of the plate, about 1.5 cm thick in the pile | 65
ITEM 2 | Whole round piece with a red-and-yellow-green blushed skin, glossy with a small stem dimple on top, about 7.5 cm across and 7 cm tall, sitting at the left center of the plate | 165
ITEM 3 | Loose cluster of dark green flat leaves with smooth, slightly glossy surfaces and visible central veins, lying on the right side of the plate near the nuts | 20
ITEM 4 | Cluster of about six dark red to purple-maroon small oval pieces, glossy skin, each about 2 cm long, lined up below and left of the apple | 35
ITEM 5 | Single small glossy orange-red oval piece, about 3 cm long, touching the lower right edge of the apple | 15
ITEM 6 | Single glossy bright red oval piece, about 3 cm long, at the right center of the plate below the leaves | 17
ITEM 7 | Single glossy orange-red oval piece, about 2.5 cm long, below and left of item 6 | 12
ITEM 8 | Single glossy bright red oval piece, about 3 cm long, at the bottom center of the plate | 15
ITEM 9 | Single glossy bright red oval piece, about 3 cm long, at the bottom right of the plate next to item 8 | 15
